integrity: The claims follow from a complete analytic argument and independently coded reproducibility checks. Numerical experiments are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The local initial chord-density coefficient is contained in older general polygon chord formulas. The asserted quantitative novelty is the universal sharp angle-variance stability bound. The theorem applies to nondegenerate convex polygons, not smooth bodies or anisotropic line measures. Source-access limitations leave some historical-priority risk; no independent audit was performed.
title: Sharp side-count-uniform angular stability from short Crofton chords
